description: Ask one whole sports betting price question in plain English, the way a person would: which book pays the most for a bet, hedge math on a ticket, a parlay price, a game's board, a past result or how a line has moved. Returns a plain-sentence answer, the time the prices were scanned and a link to the matching page on theoddsgap.com. When a question could mean more than one game, it returns the choices as plain text to ask again with. Prices may have moved since the scan. Information only: it places no bets and gives no picks.

question.description: One whole question, for example 'where is the best price on the Lions moneyline' or 'hedge my Ravens ticket at +240 for $50'.

name: ask

as_of.description: When the prices were scanned, Eastern Time.

card.description: The same answer, structured, when there is one.

decline_kind.description: Set when the question is one we do not answer, and which kind.

ok.description: True when the tool produced an answer.

options.description: When the question could mean more than one thing: whole questions to ask again with.

stale.description: True when that scan is older than usual for our hourly snapshot.

state_note.description: Where to check what is legal for you.

title: Ask a Betting Price Question
